characters.name: Alix Karr
characters.goal: clear her inspection certificate before the inquiry panel convenes

characters.name: Harte Vane
characters.goal: protect the crossing concession from being shut down

characters.name: Joram Finch
characters.goal: avoid being blamed for the deck handling

characters.name: Vesper Tallow
characters.goal: hold the district inspector accountable for Tomas's death

characters.name: Briony Karr
characters.goal: keep their household solvent through the drought

characters.name: Magistrate Orlo Ren
characters.goal: close the inquiry quickly by naming an inspector at fault

characters.name: Kest Mallow
characters.goal: shield his repair yard from liability

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establish the ferry disaster and place Alix under immediate public and professional blame.

char_alix_karr.goal: clear her inspection certificate before the inquiry panel convenes
determine why the hull breached in calm drought water

required_beats: Alix arrives at the slipway as the Osprey settles into the riverbed.
Vesper and Harte publicly accuse Alix of certifying a lethal vessel after Tomas's drowning.
Alix interrogates Joram about the crossing and disputes his claim that a minor gravel bar scrape could split sound planking.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establish the personal stakes of Alix's impending suspension through her sister's dependency on her post.
required_beats: Alix doses Briony with fever bark tincture in their back room.
Briony warns that losing the district position will cut off their apothecary access.
Alix examines the inspection ledger to review the certificate she signed for Harte.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Uncover initial evidence that illicit cargo contributed to the ferry sinking.
required_beats: Alix discovers unmanifested, waterlogged grain sacks hidden under canvas in the freight shed.
Harte intercepts Alix and attempts to explain away the wet sacks as overland cargo.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establish a strict deadline and legal threat that forces Alix to examine the wreck.
required_beats: Magistrate Orlo Ren opens the inquiry and warns Alix she will be held liable under provincial pressure unless another culprit is found.
Alix secures a forty-eight-hour window to inspect the sunken hull at low tide.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To rule out wood rot as the cause of the wreck, turning Alix's suspicion away from general neglect toward specific sabotage or mechanical failure.
required_beats: Alix probes the exposed hull timbers at low tide and finds the oak sound and unrotted.
Harte warns Alix from the pier against disturbing the wreck.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To raise the stakes for Alix's investigation by confronting her with angry townsfolk demanding accountability.
required_beats: Vesper confronts Alix with ruined freight and accuses her of taking bribes to pass an unseaworthy boat.
Alix insists she will uncover the true failure without protecting anyone.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal the physical point of failure on the scow and uncover Harte's leverage over Alix's family.
required_beats: While Joram watches, Alix dives under the stern and extracts a drainage sleeve with stripped threads jammed with a wooden wedge.
Alix confronts Harte with the botched fitting.
Harte counters by threatening the dispensary revenue and the medicine permits her sister relies on.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To shift the moral culpability for the disaster onto Alix by revealing that her own oversight caused the tragedy.
required_beats: Alix confronts Kest Mallow with the recovered wooden wedge.
Kest insists he informed her during the inspection that he used green willow as a stopgap.
Alix remembers his warning, realizing she overlooked it when signing the certificate.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establish Alix's theory that Harte's illicit cargo caused the catastrophic structural failure despite warnings of his political reach.

char_alix_karr.goal: determine why the hull breached in calm drought water
prove Harte's excess grain cargo caused the hull collapse

required_beats: Alix verifies through the freight ledgers that Harte controls all crossing contracts and moves large amounts of illicit grain.
Harte confronts Alix in her office, demanding she halt the investigation and blame the riverbed.
Alix calculates that Harte's unregistered flour overloaded the Osprey beyond its displacement limit.
Briony warns Alix against pursuing Harte due to his widespread provincial backing.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Turn Alix's pursuit from a public triumph into a precarious legal corner when her overload theory is physically disproven.

char_alix_karr.goal: prove Harte's excess grain cargo caused the hull collapse
reconstruct the exact chain of failure before dawn

required_beats: Alix publicly accuses Harte on the pier of sinking the ferry through excess cargo, backed by Vesper and the gathered crowd.
Kest demonstrates with wreck measurements that the hull's oak ribs sustained no strain or load-bearing damage, dismantling her claim.
Magistrate Orlo Ren reprimands Alix for unfounded accusations and gives her until morning to produce physical proof or face arrest for her prior certification.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Pay off the mechanical mystery of the sinking and turn Alix toward confessing her own legal culpability.

char_alix_karr.goal: reconstruct the exact chain of failure before dawn
testify truthfully before the magistrate regardless of personal cost

required_beats: Alix correlates river soundings with Joram's reported gravel contact to realize the protruding stern valve struck the riverbed.
Examining the stripped threads and salvage marks, Alix discovers the impact forced the loose wooden bung directly into the hull.
Alix confesses to Briony that she knowingly omitted Kest's warning about the green willow fitting to keep the crossing open, resolving to admit the truth at the inquiry.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Pay off the entire investigation as Alix exposes both Harte's complicity and her own negligence before the magistrate.
required_beats: Alix places the sheared flange and willow core before Magistrate Ren at the inquiry.
Alix explains how Harte's illicit freight deepened the boat's draught just enough to dislodge the valve bung on the shoal.
Alix publicly confesses that she certified the ferry despite knowing the fitting was unapproved.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To strip Alix of her livelihood and demonstrate the direct, immediate cost to Briony's survival.
required_beats: Ren terminates Alix's license and salary as the inquiry concludes.
Alix surrenders her district seal and inspection tools on the desk.
Alix measures out the final dose of fever tincture for Briony.
Briony drinks the medicine and acknowledges the cost of their honesty.

metadata.title: The Low Water Mark
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

premise.logline: A river ferry sinks in calm water, and the woman who signed off on its last inspection has to find out why before the inquiry does.

modules.theme: what a person will certify to keep a job that feeds other people
modules.setting_time: a drought summer, in a country with more paperwork than money
modules.setting_place: a river crossing town that exists because the ferry does
modules.protagonist: the district inspector who signed the ferry fit to sail
modules.protagonist_want: to find the real cause before the inquiry names her as it
modules.antagonism: the people who need the ferry running more than they need it safe
modules.complication: the cause turns out to be something she was told about and did not write down
modules.ending_shape: the truth is established and costs the person who established it

plot_shape.name: Mystery
plot_shape.central_question: What actually happened, and who is willing to say so?

phases.name: Disturbance
phases.purpose: A wrong surfaces and someone is obliged to look into it.

phases.name: Inquiry
phases.purpose: Evidence accumulates, most of it true and misread.

phases.name: Wrong turn
phases.purpose: A reading of the evidence that is coherent and wrong collapses.

phases.name: Solution
phases.purpose: The true account, assembled only from what the reader has already been shown.

phases.name: Cost
phases.purpose: What knowing costs the person who found out.

cast_roles.purpose: Carries the reader through the inquiry and pays its cost.
Has a reason to keep the true account from being assembled.
Holds one true piece and misunderstands its meaning.
The reason the question matters at all.

obligatory_moves: Every element of the true account is on the page before it is stated.
At least one true detail is shown early in a context that makes it look irrelevant.
The wrong reading is defensible on the evidence available when it is made.

events.summary: Alix Karr arrives at Low Pier as the sunken ferry settles into the riverbed, where Vesper Tallow publicly accuses her of certifying a death trap.
events.dramatic_function: Establishes the inciting catastrophe, the stakes of the drowning, and the protagonist's direct professional jeopardy.
beats: Alix watches the ferry Osprey settle upright on the river bottom in glassy, drought-slack water.
Vesper confronts Alix over his brother Tomas, who was trapped under freight wagons and drowned.
Harte shouts over the onlookers that the vessel held an official certificate signed by Alix.

events.summary: Alix questions deckhand Joram Finch, who mentions that the hull scraped the river bottom gravel bar lightly on the morning run.
events.dramatic_function: Plants a crucial mechanical detail in an innocuous conversation where it appears to be harmless drought routine.
beats: Joram shivers on the pier steps, insisting the crossing was calm until water surged into the stern bilge.
He casually mentions the keel brushed the mid-channel gravel bar earlier, as it had done every drought morning.
Alix points out that soft silt brushing could never split sound bottom planking.

state_changes.value: determine why the hull breached in calm drought water

events.summary: Alix returns to her office to check the registry and doses Briony with bark tincture, mindful that suspension will stop their income.
events.dramatic_function: Establishes the personal urgency behind holding the inspector post to feed and medicate her sister.
beats: Alix measures the remaining draughts of fever bark for Briony in their back room.
Briony reminds her that losing the district post means losing access to the apothecary ration.
Alix opens the sealed inspection ledger to review the certificate she granted to Harte.

events.summary: Alix searches the Low Pier freight shed and discovers sacks of unmanifested grain soaked through with river water.
events.dramatic_function: Uncovers material evidence of illicit loading that shifts suspicion toward commercial greed.
beats: Alix inspects the freight house and finds wet grain sacks concealed beneath canvas awnings.
She notes private mill markings missing from the official wharf ledger.
Harte catches her in the shed and claims the sacks arrived on a separate overland wagon.

events.summary: Magistrate Orlo Ren opens the inquiry in the town hall and warns Alix that provincial authorities require a culprit by week's end.
events.dramatic_function: The formal institutional timer starts, tightening pressure on the protagonist.
beats: Orlo sets out the formal inquiry papers and quotes the ministry edict demanding rapid closure.
He warns Alix that an inspector's signature on a sunken vessel makes her the default target.
Alix requests forty-eight hours to complete a low-tide inspection of the sunken hull.

events.summary: At evening low tide, Alix wades out to the exposed hull strakes and discovers the bottom planking is sound and completely free of rot.
events.dramatic_function: Eliminates simple structural decay or shipworm rot as the source of the catastrophe.
beats: Alix wades through thigh-deep silt to probe the exposed lower timbers with a carpenter's awl.
She confirms the oak planking is solid heartwood with no softness or shipworm tunnels.
Harte warns her from the pierhead that tampering with the wreck risks shifting the shoals.

events.summary: Vesper Tallow confronts Alix outside his cooperage, showing her freight splinters and threatening retribution if she shields the ferry master.
events.dramatic_function: Escalates personal danger and reinforces the moral weight of Tomas's death.
beats: Vesper drops crushed barrel hoops and cart timber at Alix's feet.
He accuses her of taking bribes from Harte to certify an unseaworthy scow.
Alix promises him that the physical failure of the hull will be uncovered without favor.

events.summary: Alix dives beneath the stern counter at dead low water and wrenches out the bilge plug assembly, finding stripped brass threads.
events.dramatic_function: Recovers the key physical artifact containing the mechanical defect.
beats: Alix uses a spanner under the water line while Joram keeps watch on the pier.
She unseats the bronze drainage sleeve and finds its female screw threads stripped flat.
She notices a carved wooden wedge jammed into the stripped metal casing.

events.summary: Alix confronts Harte Vane with the stripped valve, but he reminds her whose trade revenue pays the town dispensary.
events.dramatic_function: The concealer leverages the town's economic survival against the investigator.
beats: Alix displays the damaged bronze fitting and demands to know who seated it.
Harte retorts that without ferry revenue, the district dispensary loses its subsidy.
He reminds her that her sister's fever bark travels on his trade permits.

events.summary: Alix questions Kest Mallow at the dry dock, where he reveals he warned her during the inspection that he used green willow wedging on the bung.
events.dramatic_function: Plants the complication: Alix was verbally told of the makeshift repair and failed to record it.
beats: Alix confronts Kest with the wooden core extracted from the brass drainage collar.
Kest snaps that he told her on the slipway he had driven unseasoned willow as a stopgap.
Alix suffers a sickening pang of memory, recalling his comment as she signed the certificate.

events.summary: In her office, Alix cross-checks the district freight books and confirms Harte holds a complete monopoly over crossing manifests.
events.dramatic_function: Builds the plausible foundation for the wrong hypothesis of deliberate corporate overloading.
beats: Alix cross-references the crossing permits and finds Harte's stamp on every cargo contract.
Harte arrives to demand she close her investigation and blame riverbed shifts.
Alix realizes the volume of illicit grain moving under Harte's personal authority.

events.summary: Alix constructs a coherent theory that Harte overloaded the ferry with illicit grain to the point of catastrophic bottom failure.
events.dramatic_function: The wrong turn: Alix commits to a defensible but mistaken interpretation of the evidence.
beats: Alix tallies the tonnage of unregistered flour against the Osprey's maximum displacement.
She concludes that Harte's greed caused excessive weight that stove in the hull timbers.
Briony urges caution, noting that Harte has political allies across the province.

state_changes.value: prove Harte's excess grain cargo caused the hull collapse

events.summary: Alix publicly accuses Harte Vane on the wharf of overloading the ferry deck and causing the structural failure.
events.dramatic_function: Public confrontation based on the wrong theory, creating dramatic escalation.
beats: Alix displays the cargo tallies and waterlogged flour before assembled townsfolk.
She declares Harte loaded twice the permitted draught, sinking the boat under weight.
Vesper joins the crowd, demanding Harte be bound over for trial.

events.summary: Kest Mallow intervenes on the wharf, proving the unrotted oak planking showed zero flex strain or cracked ribs from weight.
events.dramatic_function: The wrong turn collapses under physical evidence, discrediting the protagonist.
beats: Kest displays measuring gauges taken from the exposed wreck.
He shows that the oak frame timbers sustained no load cracking or structural distortion.
Alix's accusation of simple overloading collapse crumbles before the magistrate's clerks.

events.summary: Magistrate Orlo Ren reprimands Alix on the pier, warning her that her certification makes her solely liable at tomorrow's hearing.
events.dramatic_function: The lowest point; stripped of her false theory, Alix faces immediate disgrace.
beats: Orlo censures Alix for making baseless claims of structural overloading.
He reminds her that her signature on the certificate leaves her without defense.
He gives her until sunrise to present verified physical mechanics or be arrested.

state_changes.value: reconstruct the exact chain of failure before dawn

events.summary: Reviewing soundings in her office, Alix realizes that Joram's gravel rubbing caused the lowered stern valve to strike the shoal directly.
events.dramatic_function: First step of the solution: connecting the drought water depth to the protrusion of the drain valve.
beats: Alix plots the low-water soundings against the keel profile of the ferry.
She connects Joram's mention of light bottom contact with the lowest point under the stern.
She recognizes that the hull cleared the gravel bar, but the protruding drain collar struck it.

events.summary: Under lamplight, Alix analyzes the stripped threads and realizes the upward impact pushed the loose wooden bung directly into the hull.
events.dramatic_function: Second step of the solution: identifying the mechanical failure that produced the sudden sinking.
beats: Alix examines the sheared brass threads on the salvaged discharge flange.
She sees indentation marks showing the wooden plug was shoved upward into the bilge by bottom contact.
She realizes the boat took water not through split wood, but because the unthreaded bung popped out entirely.

events.summary: Alix confronts her own culpability, remembering Kest's verbal warning about the green willow fitting that she deliberately omitted from the ledger.
events.dramatic_function: The complication pays off; the investigator admits her own compromise in certifying the boat.
beats: Alix recalls Kest warning her three weeks ago that the temporary willow bung would shrink and loosen if bumped.
She confesses to Briony that she omitted the fitting from the register so the crossing wouldn't be closed.
She decides to bring her own fraudulent certification before the inquiry.

state_changes.value: testify truthfully before the magistrate regardless of personal cost

events.summary: At the inquiry, Alix testifies to the complete sequence of events, admitting her own omission and exposing Harte's excess freight.
events.dramatic_function: Resolution of the mystery; establishing the truth before all parties.
beats: Alix presents the sheared flange and the unseasoned wooden core to Magistrate Ren.
She explains that Harte's extra grain lowered the draft just enough for the gravel bar to knock the loose bung loose.
She publicly confesses that she certified the ferry fit to sail while knowing the fitting was unapproved.

events.summary: Magistrate Ren revokes Alix's inspector license and salary, leaving her with no way to buy Briony's medicine as the inquiry closes.
events.dramatic_function: The cost of truth; establishes the final consequence for the protagonist.
beats: Alix surrenders her district seal and inspection calipers on the office desk.
She counts out the last teaspoon of fever tincture into a cup for Briony.
Briony takes the medicine, acknowledging that the truth has cost them their livelihood.

vacuous_checks: entry_exit_contradiction — entry_state is derived from the same replay that produces exit_state (src/segmentation/state.ts), so consecutive scenes agree by construction
plant_not_declared — every accepted plant/payoff pair writes its fact into the plant scene's own reader_must_learn as it is applied
unpaid_fact — reader_must_learn is populated only from facts that some scene pays off
